articles.title: Gold, silver rates today: Comex gold fell $91/oz; silver down $4 on inflation worries, firm US dollar
articles.summary: Gold and silver prices declined on 19 May as elevated crude oil prices and a strong US dollar weighed heavily on the market. Gold fell to $4,467 and silver to $73.34, continuing losses amid inflation concerns, rising bond yields, and geopolitical tensions over the Iran conflict.

articles.title: BPCL Q4 Results: Net profit plunges 58% QoQ to ₹3,191 crore; revenue flat at ₹1.35 lakh crore
articles.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation's net profit fell 1% year-on-year to ₹3,191 crore but dropped 57.7% sequentially due to increased Exceptional Items. Revenue from operations rose to ₹1,34,896 crore, while refinery throughput was 10.40 MMT and domestic sales grew 3.28% year-on-year.

articles.title: Trident Q4 Results: Revenue slips 12% YoY, net profit comes in at ₹102 crore
articles.summary: Trident reported mixed earnings for Q4FY26, with consolidated revenue at ₹1,632.53 crore, down 12.4% year-on-year. Net profit rose to ₹101.98 crore. For FY26, total revenue was ₹6,701.05 crore, slightly lower than FY25, while net profit improved to ₹377.11 crore.

articles.title: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide up to 0.7% as tech rally loses momentum
articles.summary: US stock futures showed mild losses on May 19 amid Middle East tensions. Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.7% and S&amp;P 500 futures dropped 0.4%, marking a potential longest losing streak since March. Rising bond yields and oil prices contributed to cooling momentum in tech stocks.

articles.title: Teamtech Formwork Solutions IPO: Issue booked over 50% on first day; check GMP, price band and other details
articles.summary: Teamtech Formwork Solutions IPO: The ₹50.15-crore SME IPO is entirely a fresh issue of 0.80 crore shares sold in the price band of ₹61 to ₹63 per share. Since the offer has no OFS component, all proceeds will be received by the company.

articles.title: Rupee slides 7% YTD as crude shock weighs: Can end to US-Iran war offer any long-lasting respite?
